svg.title: The UK expects a smaller drop in neural tube defects than Canada and the US saw
svg.desc: Fall in neural tube defects after flour fortification: Canada 46% (observed, 1993 to 2002), United States 28% (observed, 1995 to 2011; 35% where prenatal diagnoses were counted), United Kingdom 19% (government model, range 12 to 27%). In England, the impact assessment expects each year about 112 fewer terminations, 31 fewer babies born with a neural tube defect and 6 fewer miscarriages.
